text:
noah (Design): quick sketch: combined 'channel stack' + mini-timeline. idea is to show recurring low-noise alerts as pale bands and true spikes as bold bars. want copy + a11y takes.

anya (Product): looks promising. suggestion: call the timeline 'Recent activity' and keep a short legend. users get confused by 'heatmap' wording.

devon (Eng): perf: return only summaries for timeline; defer full examples until click. backend idea: /v1/projects/:id/alert-timeline-summary -> [{channel, score, last_seen}].

noah (Design): good call on the label. I'll rename to 'Recent activity' and add a compact legend.

sasha (A11y): keyboard flow: tiles must be reachable by Tab. when a tile gains focus, announce "channel X: high frequency, last 2 hours". avoid hover-only controls.

anya (Product): copy nit: change 'Notification preview' to 'Example alert' and add a short recipient line. also add an explicit 'Lock order' control instead of 'Pin' to reduce mental load.

devon (Eng): lock order = stored per-project. API payload: {"channels":[{"id":"c1","order":0,"locked":true}],"timeline_window":"24h"}. small and backend-friendly.

sasha (A11y): visual accessibility: do not rely on color alone. add pattern overlays on high-severity bars and ensure contrast on focus outlines.

noah (Design): will iterate: 'Recent activity' label, legend, 'Example alert' copy, 'Lock order' CTA, keyboard-friendly focus, and patterns for severity. posting updated mock shortly.

review-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2:00 PM PT today (topic: alerting widget).

anya (Product): thanks—if no blockers by noon I'll ping eng for estimates. :white_check_mark:
